story.title: Studio NOL Website Renewal Complete!
story.author: Studio NOL
story.summary: Hello, this is Studio NOL! 🎸🎤 Our website has been fully renewed! We worked hard to provide cleaner, more useful information. Through this renewal,...
story.content:
Hello, this is Studio NOL! 🎸🎤

Our website has been fully renewed! We worked hard to provide cleaner, more useful information. Through this renewal, you can explore the value of the analog sound we pursue and the premium services powered by our top-tier analog gear. Feel how the analog tools we carefully chose—Vintech X73i, Tegeler Vari Comp, SPL Optimizer, and more—bring special emotion to your music.

You can also take a full look at the gear we actually use: from high-end microphones like Neumann U87AI and AKG C414 XLS to professional monitoring systems such as Proac Tablett 50 and EVE Audio SC207. With the synergy of modern digital workflow and analog hardware, you’ll experience an ideal sound where warmth and clarity coexist.

The newly added services page introduces a wide range of offerings to realize your musical vision—vocal/instrument recording, professional mixing, mastering, album producing, and sound design. We hope you’ll experience Studio NOL’s sound philosophy on the new site and create magical moments that breathe depth into your music.

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us anytime by phone (02-764-3114), text (010-4255-7893), or [KakaoTalk](https://open.kakao.com/o/sgTfRiah). Studio NOL will always do our best for your precious music. Thank you for your support and love!

Sincerely,
Studio NOL
